title: Berridale, NSW - Infrastructure Restoration
current_summary: An upstream access network issue in Berridale, NSW has been resolved. Network hardware was replaced and services were restored at approximately 12:37 PM AEST on 30 July 2026. If your service has not reconnected, please restart your modem/router and any connection box.

updates.content: Services in Berridale, NSW have been restored following an issue on the access network. Work to replace faulty network hardware has been completed, and services were confirmed restored at 12:37 PM AEST on 30 July 2026. If your service has not come back online, please restart your modem/router and any connection box. We’re monitoring for stability. Thank you for your patience.
